about.commandTitle: Name of the command in the command palette that opens the About dialog.
about.versionButton: Accessible label of the button in the status bar that shows the version.
about.links.releases: Link to the list of published versions (release notes) on GitHub.
about.links.issues: Link to GitHub where bugs are reported.
about.copied: Shown briefly after the diagnostics text was copied to the clipboard.
about.close: Button that closes the About dialog.
